Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified "George Douglas, 2nd Earl of Angus" as the father of James Douglas, 3rd Earl of Angus, instead of the correct individual, "William Douglas, 2nd Earl of Angus." This error occurred at Step 2 when the Planner instructed WebSurfer to search for the birthplace of George Douglas, 2nd Earl of Angus, leading to a series of searches and instructions based on the wrong individual. This misidentification was the root cause of the failure to find the correct solution (Tantallon Castle).
